name: Install MCE on Provisioned Cluster
description: Install and configure MCE on a freshly-provisioned ROSA HCP cluster, turning it into a CAPI/CAPA management hub

playbooks.name: Install MCE on Provisioned Cluster
playbooks.description: Install the MCE operator on the new hub (via its CAPA-published kubeconfig), wire OCM/AWS creds, then enable CAPI/CAPA and disable HyperShift
playbooks.timeout_budget_comment: M1: the runner SIGKILLs this playbook at `timeout` seconds. The realistic worst case is control-plane wait (75x30=2250s) + MCE install loops (devCatalog catalog READY 600s + packagemanifest 180s + currentCSV 300s + CSV Succeeded 1200s + MCE Available 1800s + currentVersion 300s). gaCatalog (no dev catalog) sums to ~3600s of install loops; devCatalog to ~4200s. With the control-plane wait ENABLED (the default, skip_wait_for_ready=false) the worst cases are gaCatalog ~5850s (3600+2250) and devCatalog ~6630s (4200+2250). 7200s (120 min) covers the devCatalog-with-control-plane-wait worst case (~6630s) with headroom; gaCatalog runs and any run with the wait skipped finish well under it. Do NOT lower below the sum of the loop budgets in tasks/install_mce_operator.yml + tasks/wait_for_rosa_control_plane_ready.yml.
